reason: The hypothesis proposes introducing a high density of annealing twins into the FCC lamellae of a well-studied AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA to enhance back-stress hardening. While the overall idea of using thermo-mechanical processing to improve strength-ductility synergy in this exact alloy is extensively reported in the passages (P2, P3, P6, P22, P32, P37, P38), the specific mechanism of intentionally promoting annealing twins as the primary mediator is not proposed or investigated in any of the provided passages. The passages focus on hierarchical microstructures, phase decomposition, and back-stress from lamellar interfaces, but none suggest tailoring twin density within the FCC phase. The hypothesis merely adds a known concept (annealing twins from TWIP steels) to an existing processing framewor
